titulo: Zelensky sacks Ukraine army chief Syrsky after protests over rival minister's dismissal
cuerpo: President Volodymyr Zelensky on Tuesday dismissed Ukraine's military head Oleksandr Syrsky following days of public pressure and named Major ​General ‌Mykhailo ⁠Drapaty, an ally of ousted defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov, as the new commander-in-chief.
